answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 42509 Country: India Title: Interest Question: My relative has deposited Rs. 200000 in bank for double amount after six years. He will get Rs. 400000 in few months. But interest is haram in Islam. So we are planning to take only Rs.200000. So please tell me where we should give interest amount Rs.200000. I am having niyat to go for 4 month's Jamat from this 24 Nov, pray for me. Answer ID: 42509 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1753/1116/L=1433) This amount should be given in charity to poor and needy one without an intention of reward. It is the ruling of interest money; it is not lawful to spend interest money in personal use. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
